mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.subtitle: The extra tools your AI apps are set up to use, on every device.
mcp.unavailable: We could not load the MCP servers. Try again in a moment.
mcp.empty: When one of your AI tools is set up with an MCP server, it shows here. Nothing found does not mean nothing is there: the list only covers devices that reported recently.
mcp.stale: This device has not reported for a while. The list may be out of date.
mcp.noFlagsHint: Manar found nothing to warn about. This is not a promise that the server is safe.
mcp.args: {count, plural, =0 {no arguments} one {1 argument (hidden)} other {# arguments (hidden)}}
mcp.privacy: Manar never collects the values of settings, passwords or keys, or the arguments a server is started with.

unknown_publisher.label: Unknown publisher
unknown_publisher.body: Manar does not recognise who makes this server. Check where it came from before you trust it with your files.

unpinned_version.label: Version not fixed
unpinned_version.body: This server is fetched fresh each time it starts, so it can change without you knowing. Ask for one exact version instead.

remote_no_tls.label: Remote, not encrypted
remote_no_tls.body: This server is on another computer and the connection is not encrypted, so others on the network could read or change what it sends.

runs_shell.label: Runs a shell
runs_shell.body: This server starts a command line. Anything it is told to run runs with your permissions.

writes_outside_home.label: Can write outside your home folder
writes_outside_home.body: This server is given a system folder or the whole disk, not just your own files.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: What each AI tool did in one sitting: commands, files, sites and your answers, in order.
sessions.unavailable: We could not load the sessions. Try again in a moment.
sessions.empty: When an AI tool on one of your devices does something, its session appears here.
sessions.sourceGapHint: This tool did not give a session id, so Manar grouped actions that are less than 30 minutes apart. Treat the boundaries as a guess.
sessions.sourceHookHint: The tool gave this session id.
sessions.summary: {commands, plural, one {1 command} other {# commands}}, {files, plural, one {1 file} other {# files}}, {sites, plural, one {1 site} other {# sites}}, {tools, plural, one {1 tool call} other {# tool calls}}, {secrets, plural, one {1 secret file} other {# secret files}}
sessions.asked: {count, plural, =0 {No questions to you} one {Asked you once} other {Asked you # times}}
sessions.blocked: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing blocked} one {1 blocked} other {# blocked}}
sessions.duration: Lasted {minutes, plural, =0 {under a minute} one {1 minute} other {# minutes}}
sessions.notFound: This session is no longer available. Sessions are kept for 30 days.
sessions.gapsTitle: Some AI tools are not recorded here
sessions.gapOff: {tool} isn't protected on {device}, so its commands don't show here. Turn it on in AI tools.
sessions.gapWaiting: {tool} isn't protected on {device} yet, so its commands don't show here. Its switch in AI tools is on, and the device hasn't applied it. If this stays, update Manar on that device by running the install command again.
sessions.emptyGaps: Commands show here only for AI tools Manar protects. Secret files they touch and sites they asked about show either way.

public.title: One AI session
public.sessionNote: Only programs, file types and site names are shown. No folders, prompts, device names or people.
